scope: Callbacks that can reach _refresh_canvases or set_pixmap after the cache test setup, explicit delivery mechanisms and activation prerequisites. No claim any callback fired during CI or timed repaint loop.

benchmark_state_distinction.panel_initial_state: LivePreviewPanel.__init__ assigns _image=None, empty masks/raw_masks/flows/cellprob at2079 onward.
benchmark_state_distinction.benchmark_assignment: Test lines501-505 calls each view.set_pixmap directly. It does not assign panel._image, image_path, raw_masks, history or start segmentation.
benchmark_state_distinction.refresh_guard: _refresh_canvases increments _canvas_epoch then returns if _imageNone (4999-5002). Ordinary display callbacks may therefore be reached without replacing the synthetic items.
benchmark_state_distinction.conditional_decode: Firstshow autoload uses form src; successful current-token worker result sets panel._image in _install_loaded_image before refreshing. A decode begun before test pixmap assignment can later replace both if delivered, but source-only evidence does not establish src configuration, pending load or actual ordering in CI.
benchmark_state_distinction.settling_limit: Cache test waits300ms afterpreview and50ms aftersyntheticimages, with no explicit pending-load/jobs-empty assertion. Timedloop has no explicit qtbot.wait/processEvents. Queued callbacks are not asserted to run inside synchronous measured loop.

callback_routes.trigger: First Live-preview show / deferred source already waiting
callback_routes.delivery_classification: Priming is synchronous; default threaded load work is off-thread, completion relayed through JobRunner (default AutoConnection; intended GUI delivery, actual affinity not observed). Nonthreaded runner executes inline.
required_prerequisites: Unprimed Live card; panel existing or lazy-built; nonempty src not path,/path/to/src,/path placeholders; successful payload with path+array; current image-load token. A pending decode may finish after synthetic pixmaps were assigned; no claim it did.

callback_routes.trigger: Direct file load, file picker/drop or source-selector change
call_path: load_image synchronously OR load_source_async via file/source input
callback_routes.delivery_classification: load_image is synchronous; load_source_async is JobRunner-delivered; channel-follow is a separately scheduled single-shot QTimer0 callback. UI handlers run on the emitting GUI path, not explicitly queued here.
required_prerequisites: Valid source/array and current async token; selector requires selected supported path, sampler/current image state. MIP reload needs existing/pending source; FOV skips same selected field; max-set change must actually change sample. Deferred follow needs unambiguous selected object channel and a moved plane/table.

callback_routes.trigger: Normalise / percentiles / outline thickness / background controls / right-view mode
callback_routes.delivery_classification: Default widget signal connections; direct when ordinary same-GUI-thread controls emit. Programmatic setter emissions can use the same path; no explicit queued connection in these hookups.
required_prerequisites: A control actually emits; _image must be nonNone for _refresh_canvases to reach item setters. Outline auto-colour change can reroll before refresh.

callback_routes.trigger: Display plane / primary object / object-channel / table selection / cycle arrows
callback_routes.delivery_classification: Ordinary GUI callbacks synchronous; different-image load returns through JobRunner. _after channel-follow is deferred. Internal channel setter blocks signals and explicitly refreshes once when moved.
required_prerequisites: Existing image for final refresh; selected object/channel or nonempty cycle stops; valid table item path. Primary object signal also directly connects refresh before other follow/recompute handling. Same-image table branch uses current image; different path/projection reloads.

callback_routes.delivery_classification: Default GUI dialog signal callback; no explicit queued connection in this hookup.
required_prerequisites: An actual settings dialog was opened and finishes; _image nonNone for image replacement. Benchmark does not itself open this dialog.

callback_routes.delivery_classification: Explicit Qt.QueuedConnection into @Slot receivers; work results handled on panel receiver context, then downstream calls synchronous.
required_prerequisites: run_preview successfully begins with loaded image; current run token; matching Flows/Cell probability mode for those refreshes. Finished masks must be nonempty/no error for recompute. Benchmark contains no explicit run_preview call.

callback_routes.trigger: Post-filter edits or successful segmentation re-filter
callback_routes.delivery_classification: GUI edits/debounce timeout synchronous entry; filtering off-thread in default JobRunner and relay-return; direct _recompute_masks runs inline. Actual JobRunner receiver affinity not executed here.
required_prerequisites: Nonempty _raw_masks; image for worker overlay route; current _filter_token. Overlay may be reused only if canvas epoch unchanged; otherwise full refresh. Failure with _imageNone explicitly clears mask using null QPixmap. No filter or raw-mask prerequisite is established by assigning synthetic view pixmaps.

callback_routes.delivery_classification: Default GUI signal/direct setters; no worker or forced queue in this path.
required_prerequisites: Selected index within _history; recorded snapshot image/masks. This uses history data directly, independent of _refresh_canvases guard. Benchmark does not create or scrub history.

callback_routes.delivery_classification: Direct synchronous call after supplied layers compose.
required_prerequisites: Nonempty composition; affects separate _compare_view, not either benchmark item.

delivery_precision.synchronous: Direct Python method chains and ordinary same-GUI-thread widget signal handlers remain synchronous unless a route schedules load/filter/timer work.
delivery_precision.explicit_queued: Segmentation results use Qt.QueuedConnection and @Slot receivers at3968-4021.
delivery_precision.timer_deferred: _after0 at2908 creates owner-parented single-shot QTimer, with callback after event-loop scheduling; filter debounce likewise schedules future timeout.
delivery_precision.JobRunner: Default threaded submit captures worker result, _relay emits _settled and _on_settled calls on_done only for current generation. Source intends GUI delivery; connection at165 uses default AutoConnection, _on_settled lacks explicit @Slot/QueuedConnection. Actual receiver registration/thread context remains unverified; do not turn its docstring into measured affinity proof or declare a threading defect. threaded=False executes callback inline.

primary_reference.paraphrase: Qt for Python recommends explicit Slot decoration and describes receiver context for Auto/Queued connections. This supports distinguishing explicit queued slots from inferred relay delivery; actual runtime has not been inspected.

conditional_guard_constraints: A content-revision guard must not skip new-image state installation, reset/fit semantics, scene bounds, pointer/ruler calibration, channel choice or model/mask/probability/flow changes merely because display pixels compare equal.
Keep original-resolution QPixmap returned by picture() for export; never substitute only device-scaled cache bytes for source image. Preserve picture_name and right-mode export naming.
Null QPixmap clears active image; show_message clears item and disables stale picture export. Repeated-content optimization must not preserve an old image over a required message/blank state.

Preserve _canvas_epoch/token/generation semantics: filter overlay is discarded if epoch changed, and stale load/run/filter results must remain rejected. A guard before state invalidation can make stale overlays appear current.
History scrub and compare panel are separate direct-setter routes; any item reuse must preserve their explicit reset/visibility and correct source/mask pairing.
No guard implementation or source repair proposed as accepted. Repeated callback/pixmap recreation during CI remains an unmeasured hypothesis.
coverage_limits: Static AST enumerates direct _refresh_canvases/set_pixmap calls in LivePreviewPanel and selected signal/worker/source entry paths. Arbitrary external invocations, runtime subclass/monkeypatch behavior and all global navigation/restoration paths are not exhaustively proven.
No actual src value, pending jobs, event delivery order/thread identity, item cache-hit/eviction count, pixel parity, measured timing or source defect is established.
No tests, imports of app/Qt/models, GUI/GPU, timing/profiling, app source/cache/threshold edits, env/package changes or refs/push.

related_prior_review.scope: Prior source setup/invalidation observations, not runtime acceptance.
